statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a diagnosis consistent with sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The denial reason code is CO-97
The service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to assess for potential atrial fibrillation or other embolic sources
